advantages_and_limitations: Shorter history; more recent behavior and fewer historical events, but no complete annual cycle.
Intermediate history; more behavioral coverage than 180 days, but still shorter than a full annual cycle.
Complete one-year cycle; supports seasonal coverage and a stable behavioral history, at the cost of excluding customers with no purchase in the year.
Maximizes historical evidence and includes a complete annual cycle, but creates unequal history lengths and greater exposure to older behavior.
